Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Best Friends For-NEVER!

Offer:

I heard what you did to your friend, Grapplin' Gertie, in the Limitless Lower Locationals. They say she won't fight again. I don't want to play with you any more. I think you're a meanie.

And a poopie-head.
